{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check data types and missing values
print(trial_df.info())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {trial_df.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check distribution of key variables
print("\nSex distribution:")
print(trial_df['sex'].value_counts())

print("\nArm distribution:")
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nResponse rate by sex:")
print(trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean())

print("\nResponse rate by arm:")
print(trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean())"}
